problem: What is the radius of the sphere ${x}^{2}+{y}^{2}+6y+(z-1)^{2}=16?$

feedback.problem: What are the radius $r$ and the coordinates of the center $C$ for the sphere $(x+2)^{2}+{y}^{2}+(z-3)^{2}=4?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Remember that the equation of a sphere centered at $({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})$ with radius $r>0$ is given by

$$
(x-{x}_{0})^{2}+(y-{y}_{0})^{2}+(z-{z}_{0})^{2}={r}^{2}.
$$

We can write our equation as

$$
(x-(-2))^{2}+{y}^{2}+(z-3)^{2}={2}^{2},
$$

which gives us the center at the point point $C(-2,0,3)$ and the radius $r=2.$
